prompt: Who won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics?
reply:
**Francis Halzen** won the **2026 Nobel Prize in Physics**, as the sole laureate, “for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin.”

Source: [NobelPrize.org](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/2026/summary/).
